propositions: Ticking AC checkboxes does not invalidate attestations because checkbox state is normalized out of the material basis before hashing
Every current staleness message names a fixed list (description/AC/file_impact/children) that does not match the actual four-key basis, hiding which component actually changed
The material basis is a single composite sha256 over exactly ticket_id, description, file_impact, children (plus file_impact_scope when scope is none), not including AC as a separate component

Pre-330c attestations hashed raw descriptions, so when boxes are later ticked neither the normalized recompute nor the legacy grandfather can match, causing spurious stale-material reports with no component named

Per-component fingerprints must come from the signed manifest, not reconstructed at read time, because children is derived from other tickets' state at read time and could diverge from what the reviewer saw

All attestation refusal surfaces must be swept to name changed components consistently: stale-material reasons, stale-reopened timestamps, unsigned gate messages, dependency-material changes, and child-closure validity details
